name: _setTip() stops stamping the marker
why: Without data-mb-tip the engine cannot tell the script's own titles from native ones, so none becomes a card.

name: native MusicBrainz titles become cards too
why: Drops the data-mb-tip ownership check: an entity link's sort-name title is stashed and drawn as a card.

name: sa_rich_tooltips is ignored
why: The setting no longer turns the cards off.

name: the stashed title is never given back
why: Leaving the element does not restore its title, so the native fallback and every later hover lose the text.
grep: shows as a Liner notes card

name: the delay setting is ignored
why: The card shows at once whatever sa_rich_tooltip_delay_ms says.

name: a title changed under the pointer is not picked up
why: The mousemove no longer re-stashes a new title: the card keeps the old text and the browser can draw the new title on top.

name: a mousedown no longer hides the card
why: The card stays over the element after a click, unlike a native tooltip.

name: the Liner notes layer drops below the 📊 dropdown again
why: Removes the shared z-index from .mb-tt-liner: #mb-stat-tooltip falls back to auto and the dropdown (999999) covers the card of its own entries (reported 2026-10-04).

name: a card opens on a filter-matched Relationships icon again
why: Removes the engine's step-aside for Relationships icons: the card stashes the title first, so the Relationships plain panel loses its text, and the URL shows as a third box (reported 2026-10-04).

name: a card opens over the cover-art preview and card again
why: Empties the list of rich tooltips that rule a card out: an inline CAA thumbnail's own title ('8 images found …') is drawn over its preview (reported 2026-10-04).

name: the Relationships plain panel is clamped onto the rich one again
why: Restores the x=5 clamp when the plain panel fits on neither side: in a narrow window it lies on top of the rich panel.
